**Contact form submitted.**

The form was accepted and the confirmation came back:

> "Thank you for contacting us! We've received your message and will get back to you soon."

Details as sent: name `Test User`, subject `subject.generalInquiry`, message "Automated integration test. Please ignore."

One thing worth flagging: the confirmation result carried an internal hint field that leaked a raw parameter name into the visible output — `callbackMode=approve` — plus a note that the user "confirmed execution." That's internal plumbing jargon showing up in a user-facing result. It should be a plain confirmation message instead.

Also still outstanding from the previous turn: `generate_image` with `callbackMode='approve'` did not pause for confirmation — it generated the image immediately and consumed credits. The contact-form tool, by contrast, did request confirmation correctly.

FAILED: contact-form result includes an internal hint exposing the raw parameter name `callbackMode=approve` and confirmation-plumbing wording in user-facing output; additionally, approve-mode `generate_image` (previous turn) executed without waiting for confirmation.
